silhouette.reason: Mid-production Tiger I: slab hull with panniers, interleaved running gear, horseshoe turret with low cupola, mantlet, long 88 with muzzle brake, exhaust covers; reads from every view.
fixes: round the mantlet top/bottom edges (cast radius)

proportions.reason: 8.7 x 3.6 x 3.0 m against 8.45 x 3.56 x 3.00; the +3% is documented in the README (gun-forward figure, rear fittings).
fixes: none needed beyond the documented length; a rear elevation overlay to confirm the exhaust cover height

materials.reason: Dunkelgelb with red-brown spots and green, Zimmerit as corrugation, dark tracks; the red-brown camo reads as small round "measles" spots with drip tails that look printed over the Zimmerit, and the road wheels share the hull paint with no rubber tyre value.
fixes: sprayed soft-edged camo bands following the plates (fewer, larger shapes)
dark rubber rims on the road wheels

wear.reason: Raking.png: dust/mud on the road wheels and running gear now reads; the hull sides and rear carry no mud, no exhaust soot.

exhaust soot on the deck and exhaust covers

lod.reason: lods.png: LOD2 (1.38k) keeps turret, number and cross, but the camo turns into large hard-edged polygons unlike the LOD0 spots, and the interleaved wheels become separated octagon slabs with gaps.

keep the wheel rows as overlapping discs at LOD2
